[ TOOLS.02 ] - Utility

Contrast
Grid

Most checkers test one pair at a time. Paste your entire palette and this one scores every combination against WCAG AA and AAA in a single matrix, so you can see which pairs are actually safe to ship.

// Expected Output

Standard WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio
Thresholds AA 4.5, AA Large 3.0, AAA 7.0
Input Hex, RGB, or named colours
Server calls Zero, runs locally
Offline support Yes, download the .html

Part of a growing toolkit built with the same logic as every client project: fast, focused, and free.

Hex, rgb(), hsl(), or a CSS colour name. Add a label after the value and it shows up in the headers.

// Text Size Being Judged

Large means 24px and up, or 18.66px and up when bold. It gets an easier ride: AA drops to 3.0 and AAA to 4.5.
